name: Usage
soft_passes: #2 dial ~15px right / ~5px up of true centre, pulled off-axis by asymmetric corner hardware; passes on centring not balance
#3 solid-black silhouette is just a squircle; subject carries entirely through internal luminance contrast, not outline
failures: #4 16px squint: PCB hairlines + all four corner devices smear to mud, segmented dial collapses to a broken ring; only the violet glow-arc survives, giving Dock-distinguishability but not subject identity
#10 variant robustness: baked raster with hand-painted bevels/shadows and a background-dependent glow, no layer separation; cannot survive macOS 26 light/dark/clear/tinted recomposition

palette.background: graphite faceplate ramp #0D0C13 (etched valleys) -> #4F5056 (bezel highlights), cool violet cast, tone-on-tone PCB etch

light_model: dual + coherent: top-down environmental key on the raised bezel (lit top edge #323047, shadowed bottom) plus an internal violet emissive source in the dial well; emissive-plus-directional is physically consistent for a glowing-display object
layer_stack: graphite faceplate + etched PCB circuit traces
raised bevelled bezel frame with four corner hardware devices (screw TL, twin heatsink slots TR, 3x2 vent-dot grid BL, twin circles BR)
violet emissive glow rising through lower-right blades (activity/load indicator)
devices: emissive turbine/aperture dial as an activity gauge (glow = load)
machined bezel with functional faceplate hardware (screw, heatsink slots, vent dots, ports)
rhymes_hint: hardware/system-internals utility icons (iStat Menus, Macs Fan Control, TG Pro, Razer/Corsair peripheral suites) and cyberpunk/sci-fi HUD glyphs (emissive ring on dark tech surface); the gunmetal-faceplate-plus-glow family
notes: Source is a 400x400 web render, NOT the 1024 master — PCB hairlines sit at the resolution floor and the violet glow shows mild webp banding; all hex (measured) off 400px, compression-shifted a few levels. Dial optical centre ~(215,195) vs canvas (200,200). Full-bleed plate = no meaningful external silhouette; legibility is internal-contrast only. Brand coherence with app: cover.png UI uses the same violet/indigo primary accent (ring gauges, bar charts) and the fan icon appears in its dock — icon<->app coherence is ACCENT-ONLY, since the app UI surfaces are light/bright while the icon is dark graphite. Structural era-fit weakness (baked light, background-dependent glow, non-layered) mirrors Bartender 6's legacy skeuo icon — shared skeuomorphic-quote liability on #4/#10; watch for a cluster as more revival icons are digested. Not a Liquid Glass or Big Sur icon; it commits fully to a machined sci-fi device faceplate.
